info_feature_2: 9@● Players can select any bet amount to play the game, and can also turn on the "Buy Free Games" or "Double Chance" feature to increase the chance of winning.
info_feature_4: 9@● Bet 100 times the bet amount to trigger Free Games.
info_feature_6: 9@● When this feature is turned on, the chance of winning Free Games for each spin will be increased to 1.2 times the normal chances.
info_feature_9: 9@● Free Game Symbol substitutes for all symbols.
info_feature_10: 9@● In the main game, appearing 3 / 4 / 5 Free Game Symbols awards 2x / 4x / 20x the total bet and triggers 10 / 12 / 15 Free Games respectively.
info_feature_13: 9@● At the beginning of each spin in the main game, one symbol (except the Free Game Symbol) is randomly chosen to be the Chosen Symbol of the spin. If the number of reels on which the Chosen Symbol appears is equal to or greater than the minimum winning combination required for that symbol, the Chosen Symbols will spread to fill the reels after the win is calculated.
info_feature_14: 9@● Winning combinations formed by the spread Chosen Symbol will be paid anywhere, including but not limited to consecutive combinations from the leftmost to the right.
info_feature_17: 9@● At the beginning of the Free Game, one symbol (except the Free Game Symbol) is randomly chosen to be the Chosen Symbol of the Free Game. If the number of reels on which the Chosen Symbol appears is equal to or greater than the minimum winning combination required for that symbol, the Chosen Symbols will spread to fill the reels after the win is calculated. The Chosen Symbol will not be changed in the Free Game.
info_feature_18: 9@● Winning combinations formed by the spread Chosen Symbol will be paid anywhere, including but not limited to consecutive combinations from the leftmost to the right.
info_feature_19: 9@● In the Free Game, x2, x3, x5, x8, x10, x12, x15, x20, x25, x30, x40, x50, or nothing may appear above each reel on the multiplier reels.
info_feature_20: 9@● If multipliers appear on the multiplier reels above the spread Chosen Symbols, the wins from the Chosen Symbols are multiplied by the sum of all multipliers.
info_feature_21: 9@● In the Free Game, appearing 3 / 4 / 5 Free Game Symbols awards 2x / 4x / 20x the total bet and additional 10 / 12 / 15 Free Games respectively.
info_feature_22: 9@● The total number of Free Games is capped at 100.
info_feature_23: 9@● Free Games are played at the same bet level as the spin that triggered the Free Game feature.
info_feature_24: 9@● Free Game wins are awarded to the player after the round completes.
info_paytable_1: 9@● All winning combinations will be paid from the leftmost to the right.
info_paytable_2: 9@● Only the highest winning combination will be paid per line. Multiple line wins are added together.
info_paytable_3: 9@● The winning combination is paid accordingly to the payout of the paytable. Payouts are displayed based on total bet.
info_paytable_4: 9@● All values are expressed as actual wins in currency.
info_paytable_6: 9@● The game is played with fixed 10 pay lines. Line bet = total bet / 10.
info_paytable_9: 9@● Two / three or more identical symbols appear in succession from the leftmost to the right.
